qa_pair.question: Systembolaget's own website can only search one flavour term at a time. Among products a customer can buy straight off the shelf for under 60 kr, exactly one has a tasting note that mentions both tobacco and cherry while not mentioning oak. Give its full product name, without the vintage.

Between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-16 inclusive, a handful of bottles are listed not for the shelves but as online allocation drops that customers apply for. Which producer made the most expensive of them?

A customer asks what to drink with lamb, for under 200 kr, and wants the fullest-bodied thing available on shelves right now. Following that request literally, what is the full name of the single product that comes out on top?
qa_pair.answer: Hyllie Bryggeri 10th Anniversary Barrel Aged Maple Stout

qa_pair.question: Bottle sizes in the assortment run from 60 ml to 30 litres, so the sticker price is not a fair comparison. Among red wines available on shelves for under 100 kr, which one is cheapest measured per litre? Give the full product name.

Several sub-types of Systembolaget's temporary assortment share the display label "Tillfälligt sortiment", but one sub-type carries the label "Säsong" instead. What is the short assortment code for that seasonal sub-type?
Producers do not agree on grape names, and the mirror normalises them. Wines whose producer wrote "Shiraz" on the label are filed under which single canonical grape name?
Consider red wines available on shelves that contain Cabernet Sauvignon among their grapes but no Syrah at all. Which country of origin contributes the most such wines?
Only a few stores have had their assortments mirrored. Exactly one of them carries the Châteauneuf-du-Pape made by Château Mont-Redon. Which store is it? Give the store name.
Of the stores whose assortments have been mirrored, which one carries the fewest products? Give the store name.

Products in the temporary assortment labelled "Tillfälligt sortiment" are not listed on random days; they cluster heavily on two weekdays. Which single weekday accounts for the most of them? Answer with the English weekday name.
